{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python - << 'PYEOF'
# Fix source: real maxsize attr is _Cache__maxsize (set by Cache.__init__), and |= with tuple
p = 'src/cachetools/tagged.py'
s = open(p).read()
old = '        self._LRUCache__maxsize = maxsize'
new = '        self._Cache__maxsize = maxsize'
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
old = '                keys |= self.__tags.get(tag, ())'
new = '                keys.update(self.__tags.get(tag, ()))'
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print('source fixed')

# Fix my own tests (miscounted evictions)
t = 'tests/test_tagged.py'
s = open(t).read()

old = '''    def test_invalidate_many_single_tag_matches_invalidate(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['x', 'y'])
        assert c.invalidate_many(['x']) == c.invalidate('y') + 1
        assert len(c) == 0
'''
new = '''    def test_invalidate_many_single_tag_matches_invalidate(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['x', 'y'])
        assert c.invalidate_many(['x']) == 2
        assert c.invalidate('y') == 0
        assert len(c) == 0
'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)

old = '''    def test_resize_shrink_evicts_lru_first(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['ta'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['tb'])
        c.put('c', 3, ['tc'])
        c.get('a')  # 'a' MRU; LRU order: b, c, a
        c.resize(2)
        assert c.maxsize == 2
        assert len(c) == 2
        assert 'b' not in c  # LRU evicted first
        assert 'c' not in c
        assert c.get('a') == 1
        # tags of survivors intact, evicted tags gone
        assert c.invalidate('ta') == 1
        assert c.invalidate('tb') == 0
        assert c.invalidate('tc') == 0
'''
new = '''    def test_resize_shrink_evicts_lru_first(self):
        c = TaggedCache(5)
        c.put('a', 1, ['ta'])
        c.put('b', 2, ['tb'])
        c.put('c', 3, ['tc'])
        c.get('a')  # 'a' MRU; LRU order: b, c, a
        c.resize(2)
        assert c.maxsize == 2
        assert len(c) == 2
        assert 'b' not in c  # LRU evicted first
        assert 'c' in c and 'a' in c
        assert c.get('a') == 1
        # tags of survivors intact, evicted tags gone
        assert c.invalidate('ta') == 1
        assert c.invalidate('tb') == 0
        assert c.invalidate('tc') == 1
'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)

old = '''    def test_resize_shrink_preserves_lru_order(self):
        c = TaggedCache(4)
        c.put('a', 1)
        c.put('b', 2)
        c.put('c', 3)
        c.get('a')  # order: b, c, a
        c.resize(2)  # evicts b, c -> survivors a, ? wait only a survives? no: len 3 -> 2 evicts b then c
        assert len(c) == 2
        # survivors: a (MRU) and... len was 3, resize to 2 evicts LRU b, then c? c is newer than b
        # LRU order after evicting b: c, a -> evict c -> only a? that's len 1
        # recompute: entries a,b,c; resize(2) evicts until len==2: evict b (LRU), then c (now LRU)
        # so only 'a' remains? No: 3 entries -> need 2, evict 1: only b evicted.
        assert c.get('a') == 1
        # now 'c' is LRU, 'a' MRU
        c.put('d', 4)
        assert 'c' not in c
        assert c.get('a') == 1 and c.get('d') == 4
'''
new = '''    def test_resize_shrink_preserves_lru_order(self):
        c = TaggedCache(4)
        c.put('a', 1)
        c.put('b', 2)
        c.put('c', 3)
        c.get('a')  # LRU order: b, c, a
        c.resize(2)  # 3 -> 2 evicts exactly 'b'
        assert len(c) == 2
        assert 'b' not in c
        assert c.get('a') == 1
        # surviving LRU order preserved: 'c' is LRU, 'a' MRU
        c.put('d', 4)
        assert 'c' not in c
        assert c.get('a') == 1 and c.get('d') == 4
'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(t, 'w').write(s)
print('tests fixed')
PYEOF
PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/test_tagged.py -q 2>&1 | tail -4"}
